name: Sergi Tattoo
bio:
Sergi Tattoo is renowned for their impeccable attention to cleanliness, ensuring both your safety and comfort throughout the tattooing process. Specializing in minimalist, geometric, and black & gray designs, Sergi's Barcelona-based studio is the epitome of hygienic practice, which is a cornerstone of their professional reputation. Clients leave not only with artful expressions inked onto their skin but also with the peace of mind that comes from a spotlessly clean environment.
